experience.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
achievements: Owned the platform's backend end-to-end since project inception (~90% of backend code), architecting the full pipeline from data ingestion through AI analysis, intelligence aggregation, AI agents, storyboard generation, asset production, and report delivery — the core product the company sells to 10+ enterprise customers in pilot across leading e-commerce, retail, and adtech brands

Built asynchronous onboarding and continuous-sync pipelines across the Facebook Marketing API, Facebook Ads Library, and AppMagic on BullMQ scheduled crons with Redis leader election, plus the internal Command Center back-office for ad-account and competitor configuration, GTM, and analysis re-triggering — onboarded 10+ enterprise advertisers and 100+ competitor brands with zero per-customer engineering work

Engineered the asset-level AI analysis pipeline that extracts scene-by-scene video breakdowns, scores every creative across 5 dimensions and 80+ sub-dimensions, and generates psychology + production 'DNA' using Gemini and Claude across 90+ structured-output LLM call sites — replacing hours of manual creative-analyst review per ad with automated insights surfaced to marketers in seconds

Designed a two-layer Knowledge Base intelligence engine combining pure-SQL computational blocks with LLM-cached strategy blocks (persona profiles, creative formulas, market archetypes, pattern gaps, competitor strategies) stored as versioned JSONB — chose this architecture to keep marketer-facing latency under 500ms while still leveraging multimodal AI, and reused it to power 5 LangGraph chat agents (data, Q&A, reporting, strategist, media buyer) that let marketers self-serve creative strategy in natural language

Shipped the storyboard and creative production pipeline that turns insights into scene-by-scene ad concepts with Imagen reference grids and produces final assets via Fal AI (Veo 3.1), OpenAI, and Bria — delivering 20 production-grade images per week and 50 videos per month to enterprise customers, built in collaboration with the CEO and creative-strategy team and compressing a multi-week agency cycle into a single in-app workflow

Delivered 13+ production PDF report types end-to-end (Competitive Intelligence, Creative Playbook, Strategy Summary, Funnel, Persona, Unified Story, Market Entry, and more) via data orchestration, LLM synthesis, Handlebars templates, and Puppeteer two-pass rendering — the platform's primary client-facing deliverable used by sales to close enterprise pilots and by customer success to drive retention and expansion

Authored the engineering team's backend coding standards, testing rulebook, and shared test infrastructure (mock factories, fixtures, jest preset) adopted across every NestJS library in the monorepo, plus the structured logging migration that cut production incident triage time
